paper.title: Transformers are SSMs: Generalized Models and Efficient Algorithms Through Structured State Space Duality

result.summary: 本文提出结构化状态空间对偶（SSD）框架，通过半可分矩阵这一桥梁，揭示结构化状态空间模型（SSM）与注意力变体之间的深层联系 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。作者证明SSM等价于半可分矩阵 [S3.SS3.p3]，并将线性注意力推广为结构化掩码注意力（SMA） [S4.SS3.p2]，进而指出标量恒等结构的SSM与1-半可分SMA互为对偶，同时具有线性与二次两种形式 [S5.SS3.p1]。基于该框架，作者设计了新的SSD算法，通过半可分矩阵的分块分解兼顾线性递归与二次对偶形式 [S6.p4]，并据此构建了Mamba-2架构 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p3]。实验表明SSD算法比Mamba的优化选择性扫描实现快2-8倍 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]，Mamba-2在语言建模上具有竞争力 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p3]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在建立结构化SSM与注意力变体之间的丰富理论联系，从而将原本为Transformer开发的算法与系统优化迁移到SSM上 [S1.p2]。作者指出，SSM的发展与社区改进Transformer的努力显得脱节，导致SSM比Transformer更难理解和实验，且从算法和系统角度都难以像Transformer那样高效训练 [S1.p1]。

evidence.quote: Our main goal is to develop a rich body of theoretical connections between structured SSMs and variants of attention.
This will allow us to transfer algorithmic and systems optimizations originally developed for Transformers to SSMs
the development of SSMs have appeared disjoint from the community’s collective effort to improve Transformers
it is more difficult to understand and experiment with SSMs compared to Transformers
it remains challenging to train SSMs as efficiently as Transformers from both an algorithmic and systems perspective

method.text: 论文通过结构化矩阵这一抽象建立SSM与注意力的联系，提出结构化状态空间对偶（SSD）框架 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。作者证明SSM等价于半可分矩阵，并将SSM的计算重新表述为结构化矩阵乘法算法 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。作者还通过张量收缩给出线性注意力的证明，并将其推广为结构化掩码注意力（SMA） [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。在此基础上，作者提出基于半可分矩阵分块分解的SSD算法，结合线性SSM递归与二次对偶形式 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

evidence.quote: Our framework connecting structured SSMs and variants of attention, which we call structured state space duality (SSD), is made through the abstractions of structured matrices
We show an equivalence between state space models and a well-studied family of structured matrices called semiseparable matrices
different methods of computing state space models can be reframed as various matrix multiplication algorithms on structured matrices
We first provide an incisive proof of its recurrent form through the language of tensor contractions, and then generalize it to a new family of structured masked attention (SMA)
We introduce a new SSD algorithm, based on block decompositions of semiseparable matrices, that takes advantage of both the linear SSM recurrence and quadratic dual form

experiments.text: 作者在合成联想回忆任务（MQAR）上评估Mamba-2，使用比先前更难的任务设置、更长序列和更小模型 [S9.SS1.p2]。在语言建模上，作者按GPT3规格从125M到2.7B训练模型，使用Pile数据集 [S9.SS2.p1]，并在Chinchilla协议下比较约125M到约1.3B参数的缩放律 [S9.SS2.SSS1.p2]。作者还在标准零样本下游任务上评估，与使用相同tokenizer、数据集和训练长度（300B tokens）的Pythia等开源模型比较 [S9.SS2.SSS2.p1]。此外，作者对SSD算法与Mamba扫描实现及FlashAttention-2进行了速度基准测试 [S9.SS3.p1]。

evidence.quote: We compare on a challenging version of the MQAR setup from, using a harder task, longer sequences, and smaller models.
The model sizes (depth and width) follow GPT3 specifications, from 125m to 2.7B. We use the Pile dataset
Figure 9 shows scaling laws under the standard Chinchilla protocol, on models from $\approx 125M$ to $\approx 1.3B$ parameters.
most importantly Pythia which were trained with the same tokenizer, dataset, and training length (300B tokens) as our models
We benchmark the speed of the SSD algorithm against Mamba’s scan implementation and FlashAttention-2

findings.text: SSD算法比Mamba的优化选择性扫描实现快2-8倍，同时允许更大的循环状态尺寸 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。SSD与优化的softmax注意力实现（FlashAttention-2）相比具有竞争力，在序列长度2K处交叉，在16K长度时快6倍 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。在MQAR任务上，Mamba-1表现挣扎，而Mamba-2在所有设置下表现良好，且即使控制状态尺寸（N=16）也显著优于Mamba-1 [S9.SS1.p3]。在缩放律上，Mamba-2在困惑度和实际墙钟时间上均帕累托优于Mamba和Transformer++ [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p3]。在Pile上训练的2.7B参数Mamba-2（300B tokens）优于Mamba-2.8B、Pythia-2.8B甚至Pythia-6.9B [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p3]。

evidence.quote: A dedicated implementation of SSD is $2-8\times$ faster than the optimized selective scan implementation of Mamba
while simultaneously allowing for much larger recurrent state sizes
crossing over at sequence length 2K and 6 $\times$ faster at sequence length 16K
While Mamba-1 struggles on this task, Mamba-2 performs well across all settings.
it is significantly better than Mamba-1 even when the state sizes are controlled ($\mathtt{N}=16$)
finding that it Pareto dominates Mamba and Transformer++ in both perplexity and wall-clock time
Mamba-2 with 2.7B parameters trained on 300B tokens on the Pile outperforms Mamba-2.8B, Pythia-2.8B and even Pythia-6.9B

limitations.text: 作者指出，相比先前的结构化SSM，SSD的主要限制在于状态转移A_t的表达能力，SSD仅使用比对角A_t稍更受限的形式，以表达能力换取硬件效率 [S10.SS1.SSS0.Px3.p1]。作者假设或许可以改进结构化矩阵算法以推广到一般对角SSM情形 [S10.SS1.SSS0.Px3.p2]。作者还指出，Mamba-2在MQAR上显著优于Mamba-1，但不确定是架构的哪个方面起主导作用，这仍是未来工作的问题 [S9.SS1.p3]。此外，作者发现所尝试的核近似方法似乎并未优于简单的逐点非线性激活函数 [S9.SS4.SSS3.p4]。

evidence.quote: Compared to previous structured SSMs, the main restriction of SSD is on the expressivity of the state transitions $A_{t}$.
SSD differs only in a slightly more restrictive form of diagonal $A_{t}$, and trades off this expressivity for improved hardware efficiency
We hypothesize that it may be possible to refine our structured matrix algorithms to improve to the general diagonal SSM case as well.
We are not sure which aspect of the architecture is the predominant factor, which remains a question to explore in future work.
the kernel approximation methods we tried did not seem to improve over simple pointwise non-linear activation functions for $\psi$

issues.quote: it is significantly better than Mamba-1 even when the state sizes are controlled
